name: Infinity Timetable 2.4.0
notes:
What's new in 2.4.0
- New Windows program with its own window, installed like normal software (Start menu, desktop icon, opens .stt files)
- Automatic daily backups, with File > Restore a backup
- Phones on Wi-Fi: the Android app copies the timetable from the PC and sends back quick changes (File > Phones on Wi-Fi)
- Phone layout: My day, one day at a time, tap a lesson to move it to the best place, quick cover with WhatsApp, viewer mode
- Holding bay (from 2.3.0): park lessons while you rearrange

Updating keeps all your timetables, settings and your licence. The update downloads about 105 MB.
